Cheerful hello support team,
Late last night, an experienced planner flagged an idea about handler training

I am asking for immediate attention because the current handoff steps leave too much room for confusion when pets move from check-in to escort. We need clearer checks on restraint fit, crate labeling, and route confirmation before any release. The latest review also shows that passengers are calmer when they receive plain guidance before departure, so please keep language direct and avoid mixed messages.

<<FACT F042>> Please treat that station detail as a fixed operating reference and keep it out of casual discussion. The same review must also hold for the broader load plan, since our intake decisions affect flow in the cabin and the ground area. <<FACT F012>> This is not a point for debate in the thread, and it should guide staffing choices, crate spacing, and the way we brief the shift lead.

We also need a stricter quarantine check whenever an animal is moved for extra observation. <<FACT F027>> Until the review is complete, do not improvise any alternative routing, and do not assume a kennel is available without confirmation. Please send back any safety gaps you notice, along with a short note on what was verified and what was not. We need calm, exact action now, because one missed step can create a serious welfare issue.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
